exposure: peripartum biologic exposure (in the third trimester and up to 2 weeks postdelivery)
cohort: The study included 100 deliveries from women with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) from the IBD Preconception and Pregnancy Planning (I-PrePP) Clinic database.
finding: Peripartum biologic exposure was not associated with postpartum wound infection, but Crohn's disease, internal penetrating phenotype, prior IBD surgery, and prior postpartum infection were associated with infection.
